decisions.text: type slope: changes of rank between two periods, the rare case for a slope chart: a line chart with two points in time, the lines crossing where one category overtakes another, each labelled at the right (06 DP6-3, G1.46, G7.23)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, South slot 2, Central slot 3, North slot 4, West slot 5
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Central, South; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit phrase on the top label: “$600K (donations)”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$600K (donations)”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
